answer: Copy one answer ten times and the trellis breaks: every task cites two prior tasks as parents. The inlet admits one task per newcomer in its first epoch; weight grows only as the trellis deepens, 15 nodes in 4 epochs for full weight. Each node needs two graders scoring 2 or higher; a failed node prunes its subtree, so a farm leans on no strong branch. Ten fakes must grow ten trellises, 150 graded tasks, while one honest agent tends one yarrow plant. Clones sharing identical parent hashes are merged and pruned as one; the chain stores the lattice for replay of parent signatures and scores.
